attachments.origin_landmark: lateral edge of the epicranial aponeurosis over the temporal fascia (the schema takes a bone id; the true attachment is cartilage/skin and is named in the landmark text)
attachments.insertion_landmark: spine of the helix of the auricular cartilage (the schema takes a bone id; the true attachment is cartilage/skin and is named in the landmark text)

actions: draws the auricle forward and upward (vestigial in most people)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

fiber_architecture.evidence: no measured architecture recorded: no PCSA, fascicle length or force verified from a source for this muscle (Q65 rule: numbers only where a source gives them)

functional_compartments.function_note: Thin fan of fibres in front of the ear; landmark for the superficial temporal artery and the auriculotemporal nerve, which run over or beside it.
